'''2007 Worlds Day 2 David McCune DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[David McCune]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck title Poker Watto. Enqui and Kith Kan'kad (V) as written (may redlink).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[David McCune]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
